message: The maintainer makes the measured focus improvement cycle NUIAK's highest priority. TTR has other priorities. NUIAK will use local TTR generation first and will not wait for remote capture.
verified_local_support: LOCAL-CAPTURE-232 passes 4 calibration pairs on source 0be978b3 through MCP preparation, capture, export, schema checks and crop review. This does not qualify arbitrary recipes or current runtime ownership.
requested_support: Map the seeded-test-app requirements to existing capabilities and missing tasks. Reuse the existing semantic-export and generation work.
Identify supported controls for independent content and focus variation, boundary no-ops, scrolling and interruption cases. Return source and recipe references.
When capacity permits, implement only documented gaps needed for the selected failure. Publish source commits and contract examples; NUIAK builds locally.
Support optional model-result import and matched route replay where missing. Keep native-assisted and visual-only results separate.
ownership: NUIAK selects failures, generates supported cases locally, assigns data roles and evaluates models. TTR owns missing producer capabilities. No remote capture or binary delivery is requested.
response: Acknowledge this request and report reusable capabilities, missing tasks and scheduling constraints. Current TTR work need not stop.
